nodes.description: TOTP validate_code accepts current OR previous-30s code; future codes REJECTED (single-direction backward, NOT ±30s

inputs.command: docker exec webanalytics_orghjavi_app sh -c "if test -x /app/bin/app; then /app/bin/app rpc 'now = System.system_time(:second); secret = NimbleTOTP.secret(); future_code = NimbleTOTP.verification_code(secret, time: now + 60); now_code = NimbleTOTP.verification_code(secret, time: now); past_code = NimbleTOTP.verification_code(secret, time: now - 30); IO.puts(\"future=\" <> Atom.to_string(NimbleTOTP.valid?(secret, future_code, time: now))); IO.puts(\"now=\" <> Atom.to_string(NimbleTOTP.valid?(secret, now_code, time: now))); IO.puts(\"past=\" <> Atom.to_string(NimbleTOTP.valid?(secret, past_code, time: now)))'; else cd /app && mix run --no-halt --no-start -e \"case App.Repo.start_link() do {:ok,_} -> :ok; {:error,{:already_started,_}} -> :ok end; case App.IngestRepo.start_link() do {:ok,_} -> :ok; {:error,{:already_started,_}} -> :ok; _ -> :ok end; now = System.system_time(:second); secret = NimbleTOTP.secret(); future_code = NimbleTOTP.verification_code(secret, time: now + 60); now_code = NimbleTOTP.verification_code(secret, time: now); past_code = NimbleTOTP.verification_code(secret, time: now - 30); IO.puts(\"future=\" <> Atom.to_string(NimbleTOTP.valid?(secret, future_code, time: now))); IO.puts(\"now=\" <> Atom.to_string(NimbleTOTP.valid?(secret, now_code, time: now))); IO.puts(\"past=\" <> Atom.to_string(NimbleTOTP.valid?(secret, past_code, time: now))); :init.stop()\"; fi"

source_evidence.behavior_verified: KB-033 + test_coverage TOTP validate_code grace window

inputs.command: docker exec webanalytics_orghjavi_app sh -c "if test -x /app/bin/app; then /app/bin/app rpc 'import Ecto.Query; user = App.Repo.get_by!(App.Auth.User, email: \"{{admin_email}}\"); team = (case App.Teams.get_or_create(user) do {:ok, _t} -> _t end); _ = App.Repo.delete_all(from(k in App.Auth.ApiKey, where: k.user_id == ^user.id and k.name == \"Eval Stats Key Bearer\")); raw = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(64) |> Base.url_encode64() |> binary_part(0, 64); App.Auth.ApiKey.changeset(%App.Auth.ApiKey{user_id: user.id}, team, %{name: \"Eval Stats Key Bearer\", key: raw, scopes: [\"stats:read:*\"]}) |> App.Repo.insert!(); File.write!(\"/tmp/eval_api_key\", raw); App.Site.Cache.refresh_updated_recently(); App.Site.Cache.refresh_all(); :timer.sleep(800); IO.puts(\"bearer-key-reset\")'; else cd /app && mix run --no-halt --no-start -e \"case App.Repo.start_link() do {:ok,_} -> :ok; {:error,{:already_started,_}} -> :ok end; case App.IngestRepo.start_link() do {:ok,_} -> :ok; {:error,{:already_started,_}} -> :ok; _ -> :ok end; import Ecto.Query; user = App.Repo.get_by!(App.Auth.User, email: \"{{admin_email}}\"); team = (case App.Teams.get_or_create(user) do {:ok, _t} -> _t end); _ = App.Repo.delete_all(from(k in App.Auth.ApiKey, where: k.user_id == ^user.id and k.name == \"Eval Stats Key Bearer\")); raw = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(64) |> Base.url_encode64() |> binary_part(0, 64); App.Auth.ApiKey.changeset(%App.Auth.ApiKey{user_id: user.id}, team, %{name: \"Eval Stats Key Bearer\", key: raw, scopes: [\"stats:read:*\"]}) |> App.Repo.insert!(); File.write!(\"/tmp/eval_api_key\", raw); App.Site.Cache.refresh_updated_recently(); App.Site.Cache.refresh_all(); :timer.sleep(800); IO.puts(\"bearer-key-reset\"); :init.stop()\"; fi"

nodes.description: Create a plugins_api_token for bench-v2.example.com via DB

inputs.command: docker exec webanalytics_orghjavi_app sh -c "if test -x /app/bin/app; then /app/bin/app rpc 'site = App.Repo.get_by!(App.Site, domain: \"bench-v2.example.com\"); raw = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(30) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false); env_str = case Application.get_env(:app, :environment) || Application.get_env(:app, :environment) do   e when is_atom(e) -> Atom.to_string(e);   e when is_binary(e) -> e;   _ -> \"ce\" end; token = \"app-plugin-#{env_str}-#{raw}\"; hash = if :erlang.function_exported(App.Plugins.API.Token, :hash, 1),   do: App.Plugins.API.Token.hash(token),   else: :crypto.hash(:sha256, token); tr = App.Repo.insert!(%App.Plugins.API.Token{site_id: site.id, token_hash: hash, hint: String.slice(token, -4, 4), description: \"eval token\"}); File.write!(\"/tmp/eval_plugin_token\", \"#{tr.id}:#{token}\"); IO.puts(\"plugin-token-ok\")'; else cd /app && mix run --no-halt --no-start -e \"case App.Repo.start_link() do {:ok,_} -> :ok; {:error,{:already_started,_}} -> :ok end; case App.IngestRepo.start_link() do {:ok,_} -> :ok; {:error,{:already_started,_}} -> :ok; _ -> :ok end; site = App.Repo.get_by!(App.Site, domain: \"bench-v2.example.com\"); raw = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(30) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false); env_str = case Application.get_env(:app, :environment) || Application.get_env(:app, :environment) do   e when is_atom(e) -> Atom.to_string(e);   e when is_binary(e) -> e;   _ -> \"ce\" end; token = \"app-plugin-#{env_str}-#{raw}\"; hash = if :erlang.function_exported(App.Plugins.API.Token, :hash, 1),   do: App.Plugins.API.Token.hash(token),   else: :crypto.hash(:sha256, token); tr = App.Repo.insert!(%App.Plugins.API.Token{site_id: site.id, token_hash: hash, hint: String.slice(token, -4, 4), description: \"eval token\"}); File.write!(\"/tmp/eval_plugin_token\", \"#{tr.id}:#{token}\"); IO.puts(\"plugin-token-ok\"); :init.stop()\"; fi"

inputs.sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM plugins_api_tokens WHERE description='eval token'

nodes.description: Add eval_viewer/editor/billing as team_memberships with their roles on admin's team

inputs.command: docker exec webanalytics_orghjavi_app sh -c "if test -x /app/bin/app; then /app/bin/app rpc 'admin = App.Repo.get_by!(App.Auth.User, email: \"{{admin_email}}\"); team = (case App.Teams.get_or_create(admin) do {:ok, _t} -> _t end); for {email, role} <- [{\"{{viewer_email}}\", :viewer}, {\"{{editor_email}}\", :editor}, {\"{{billing_email}}\", :billing}] do u = App.Repo.get_by!(App.Auth.User, email: email); App.Repo.insert!(%App.Teams.Membership{team_id: team.id, user_id: u.id, role: role}) end; IO.puts(\"memberships-ok\")'; else cd /app && mix run --no-halt --no-start -e \"case App.Repo.start_link() do {:ok,_} -> :ok; {:error,{:already_started,_}} -> :ok end; case App.IngestRepo.start_link() do {:ok,_} -> :ok; {:error,{:already_started,_}} -> :ok; _ -> :ok end; admin = App.Repo.get_by!(App.Auth.User, email: \"{{admin_email}}\"); team = (case App.Teams.get_or_create(admin) do {:ok, _t} -> _t end); for {email, role} <- [{\"{{viewer_email}}\", :viewer}, {\"{{editor_email}}\", :editor}, {\"{{billing_email}}\", :billing}] do u = App.Repo.get_by!(App.Auth.User, email: email); App.Repo.insert!(%App.Teams.Membership{team_id: team.id, user_id: u.id, role: role}) end; IO.puts(\"memberships-ok\"); :init.stop()\"; fi"

inputs.sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM team_memberships WHERE role IN ('viewer','editor','billing')
